signedCommit.description: A signed commit over the current state of a permissioned repo (v2 authenticated transition).

ver.description: Commit format version (1 for legacy v1, 2 for authenticated-transition v2).

rev.description: Commit revision (TID), bound into the signed transcript.

hash.description: sha256 digest of the new LtHash state (32 bytes).

prevHash.description: sha256 digest of the previous LtHash state (32 bytes), if any.

sig.description: Cryptographic signature over the canonical commit domain and fields.

path.description: Canonical operation path (collection/rkey) for record transitions.

action.description: Operation action (create, update, delete) for record transitions.

cid.description: New record CID for create/update transitions.

prevCid.description: Previous record CID for update/delete transitions.

val.description: Record value bytes or digest for create/update transitions.

ikm.description: Per-signature input keying material (legacy v1 compatibility).
